title.narrative: Support Initiative of Belarusian Youth CSOs

description.narrative: After the massive crackdown of civil society organizations in Belarus, youth organizations are facing a variety of challenges, including security, administrative and capacity related problems that hinder their abilities to conduct their activities in the country or the exile. To provide help for Belarusian youth organizations undergoing structural changes and security threats, build capacities on active citizenship among Belarusian youth and ensure sustainable and uninterrupted activities of Belarusian youth CSOs, this project includes several activities providing a well-rounded approach. The Organizational Clinic session aims at informing organizations on the article 193-1 and its implications, next steps after liquidation, and fundraising; Small-Scale Pool provides consultations and opportunities to acquire digital and physical tools according to their demands to increase their administrative and security capacity; and Training of Trainers will result in the establishment of a pool of trainers ensuring the continuous educational capacity across organizations.
